hello: This is the voice you'll hear in Last Stand. Zombie, far left.
train0: Training. There are five lanes in front of you. Listen: here they are, from far left to far right. You're aiming at the center one. A zombie is coming into the center lane, chained to a post. It can't reach you. Tap to shoot it.
train1: Got it. Your gun holds eight bullets. Swipe down to reload. Try it now.
train2: Good. The next one is in the far right lane. Swipe right twice: each swipe plays a higher note. You'll hear a soft tick when you're aiming at it. Then tap.
train3: Now one in the left lane. Swipe left until you hear ticking: it ticks for as long as you're aimed at one. Then tap.
train4: Last thing. Swipe up any time to hear your bullets, your health, which lane you're aiming at and where the nearest one is. Try it.
traindone: That's everything. Start the fight when you're ready.
